prompt: Vertical 9:16 1990s VHS camcorder frame grab at night: tape noise, colour bleed, soft focus. A figure in a black balaclava crouches at a kerbside drain on a wet British high street and lets a large brass key drop through the grate. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Behind, through a lit shop window, a money printing press runs on its own, steady, nobody near it, a mechanical counter glowing. Orange streetlight, puddle reflections. Thanks.
